title: showipmac – Local network devices
name: Custom name
merge_note: After confirmation, these entries will be treated as the same device and their device information will be combined. Existing custom names are retained in the details. No data is changed without confirmation.
select_two: Please select one or two devices (Ctrl + click).
ready: Ready. Select a local network and start scanning.
no_network: No active local network with an IPv4 subnet found.
complete: Scan completed: {found} devices found · {new} new · {known} known.
cancelled: Cancelled. Previous device data is retained.
network_changed: Network configuration changed. Please refresh networks.
large_network: Large IPv4 network: only existing neighbors checked; active discovery is incomplete.
probe_failed: Some addresses could not be actively probed.
no_ping: Ping is missing. Only existing neighbor entries are shown.
ipv6_observed: IPv6: locally observed neighbors only. A scan does not prove completeness; cached entries may be stale.
private_mac: Locally administered/private MAC: vendor unknown; recognition is uncertain.
identity_note: MAC matching is a heuristic within this network, not proof of identity. New MAC addresses are not automatically linked to old devices.
updating: Downloading vendor data directly from IEEE …
about_text:
Local network discovery · Version {version}
Author: Josef · License: GPL-3.0-only
OUI identifies an organization, not a model, device type or retail brand.
No telemetry. Device data stays local.
config_error: Settings are damaged or invalid. The original file is retained; defaults are being used.
oui_error: Vendor data could not be loaded. Please update.
cli_description: Display devices on the local network.
missing_gtk: GTK 4 / PyGObject is missing. python3-gi and gir1.2-gtk-4.0 are required.
app_subtitle: Discover devices on the local network
oui_downloaded: Vendor data downloaded: {date} (source date not provided)
vendor_http: IEEE rejected the download (HTTP {status}). Existing vendor data is retained. Please try again later.
vendor_network: IEEE is currently unreachable or responding too slowly. Existing vendor data is retained.
vendor_invalid: Vendor data could not be fully validated or saved. The existing database is retained.
port_number_note: LAN 1, LAN 2, etc. enumerate detected LAN interfaces by interface name. These do not claim to be physical socket numbers.
export_local_file: Please select a local file to save.
export_database_protected: An export cannot overwrite the active device database.
source_url: GitHub base address for language packs (optional)
language_pack_note: Custom JSON language packs include translations and offline help. DE/EN remain bundled. Existing packs are not overwritten.
language_wrong_program: This language pack does not belong to showipmac.
language_exists: This language is already installed. Existing files are preserved.
language_failed: The language pack or catalog could not be loaded, validated or saved. See the log for details.
languages_none: All offered languages are installed, or the catalog is empty.
no_language_source: No GitHub source configured yet. Custom local language packs can be imported.
update_interval_help: One month equals 30 days. This only checks for new application versions and does not start an application task.
update_url: GitHub JSON address for version checking (optional)
no_source: Please enter the GitHub address first.
repository_placeholder: Please replace xxxx in the GitHub address with the repository name.
write_error: The settings could not be saved.
new_version: New version available: {version}. Nothing is installed automatically.
installed: Language and help installed. Save settings to apply.
file_dialog_error: The initial folder could not be opened.
protected_target: This file belongs to the application data and cannot be overwritten by an export. Please choose another location.
log_readonly: The log is read-only. Export saves a separate copy.
cannot_cancel: This operation cannot be safely cancelled.
export_empty: There are no results to export.
max_hosts_label: Maximum number of actively probed IPv4 addresses
task_scan: Discovering devices in the selected network
